purpose: Authenticated browser identities receive table SELECT capability only; PostgreSQL RLS remains the row authority for exact-vessel access.
contracts: authenticated may SELECT fleet_vessels, fleet_memberships, fleet_global_authorities, and fleet_authority_audit
authenticated receives no browser INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, or TRIGGER authority on Fleet authority tables
fleet_vessels visibility requires active exact-vessel membership or Fleet global authority
owner portal opens only after an authenticated project_owner membership resolves for the requested canonical vessel
all other vessel rows remain invisible under RLS
